author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0043048 dolichyl monophosphate biosynthetic process
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29877

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1n9-qd9EptInZ26E4xQ2drOnRt7n7rCZRryB2mk8mQCA/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
SGD 3
Uniprot 3

These will be auto-migrated to 
GO:0180047 | dolichol phosphate mannose biosynthetic process

----




Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0043048 dolichyl monophosphate biosynthetic process
